sections.heading: How to Get Your PSARA License Registration Done Quickly? The Ultimate Guide You Need!
paragraphs: Anyone who is trying to set up a private security agency in India has to get the PSARA License Registration so that they can operate legally. This license, which is governed by the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005, assures that the agency operates to all legal, operational, and quality standards.

This detailed guide explains what PSARA License Registration is, eligibility criteria, types, benefits, documentation, and the procedure to apply online step-by-step. Whether you are looking to apply online for a PSARA license or just browsing how to set up a security agency license, this article gives true and verified details that hold you.

It is the legal approval given to a private security agency to operate in India under the PSARA Act. According to the PSARA Act of 2005, it is mandatory for any individual, partnership, LLP, or company intending to provide security services.
Anyone unlawfully operating a security agency without this license may be fined or imprisoned.
Before applying for the PSARA License online, you should see if you are eligible:
Proprietorship/Partnership/LLP/Company: The applicant must be a registered entity in India.
Indian Citizenship: The majority shareholder/director should be an Indian citizen.
Financial Soundness: Must have a clean financial track record.
Criminal Record: No convictions involving moral turpitude.
Training & Infrastructure: Must have arrangements for training security personnel and a proper office setup.
The security agency license has two broad types:
State-level License: Valid for one state only.
Multi-State License: Requires separate applications in each state.
For now, there is no pan-India single license, so agencies need to apply state-wise.
Trust & Credibility: Clients prefer licensed agencies for security services.
